## Summary

What this PR changes, in 1-3 sentences.

Closes #<issue-number>

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] Docs only (`docs`)
- [ ] Tests / tooling (`test` / `chore`)
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `uv run ruff check src/ tests/` clean
- [ ] `uv run mypy src/` clean
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] If scoring changed: `docs/SCORING_ALGORITHM.md` updated + regression test added
- [ ] If a new tool was added: `docs/TOOLS_REFERENCE.md` updated

## How was this tested

Briefly describe the tests you added / ran. Include the test names if
useful.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything non-obvious — design tradeoffs, follow-up work, things you
chose *not* to do and why.
